As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Diagnoses why a check is red on untouched code by classifying the failure type (timed out, did not run, no report, under project's own bound, over bound, found problems, or failed), then asks a model to explain the cause and propose up to three fixes to be tried in a throwaway checkout.
